STATUS: done
SUMMARY: Read-only review of diff snapshot 9CBE14…: defeat/clear ordering is safe, but 3 definite issues block summons/teardown/telegraph stability.
CHANGED_FILES: none
TESTS: none — read-only, no tools per request
RISKS: steam 0.56 decoupled from `PURGE_DISCHARGE_DURATION` (old `_draw` removed, VFX hardcoded); worker in-flight rivets not flushed by boss cancel paths — verify baseline room flush; `rivet_worker.tscn` must be in `enemy_group` or `register_enemy` always fails.
NEXT_STEP: Fix 1-3 below, then re-request read-only review of updated diff.

Definite issues (evidence in diff):
1. Lost summon, no retry: `_maybe_schedule_phase_reinforcement()` sets `_phase_one/two_called=true` before warning, `_spawn_reinforcement_now()` (deferred) cancels on player-dist `<260`, `alive>=2`, `room_is_cleared`/`register_enemy==false` via `_cancel_reinforcement_warning()` without clearing flag. Player can walk into 260px in 1.05s -> phase ends with 0 summons.
2. Stale room entries on non-defeat exit: `_exit_tree()` calls `_cancel_owned_reinforcements(false)` (no `unregister_enemy`), `_finish_defeat()` uses `true`. Freed workers stay in `CombatRoom._remaining_enemies` -> room never empties, gate/rewards blocked on reset/player-death teardown.
3. Drifting hatch anchor: `PressureEffects` is child of boss (`supervisor_caldeira.tscn`), `_draw_reinforcement_hatch()` uses `to_local(_spawn_position)`. Warning `1.05s` outlives `RECOVERY 0.65s` from `_finish_attack()`, boss mobile while marker visible. Purge OK (`velocity=ZERO` during warnings).
